status_note: A summary written for ELI Legal, in its own words. It is not the text of the instrument and has not been validated by a qualified lawyer. Check the official text before relying on any statement in it. The Convention binds the states that ratify it and reaches users through national law.
title: Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law
instrument: Council of Europe Treaty Series No. 225 (2024)
description: The first international treaty on AI. It applies to AI used by public authorities, including courts.

requirements.title: Integrity of democratic processes and the rule of law
requirements.text: AI is not used to undermine judicial independence or access to justice.

requirements.title: Human dignity and individual autonomy
requirements.text: People are treated with respect for their dignity and autonomy.
requirements.instruction: Describe what a person said or did as the documents record it; do not characterise who they are.

requirements.title: Transparency and oversight
requirements.text: The system's role and limits can be seen and overseen.

requirements.title: Accountability and responsibility
requirements.text: Someone is accountable for every use and every decision.

requirements.title: Equality and non-discrimination
requirements.text: Every party's material is treated by the same standard.
requirements.instruction: Apply the same standard to each party's material and set out the arguments open to each party with equal care.

requirements.title: Reliability
requirements.text: Outputs are checked before they are relied on.

requirements.title: Remedies and procedural safeguards
requirements.text: Remedies are available for violations of rights, and the record needed to pursue them is kept.
